SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. D 4781 Date 2/9 Strong 13）
Date April 16, 1933

Subject (in full) Assistance to Chinese Authorities - unsuccessful attempt to
arrest a communist suspect named Yang Ah Zai (杨阿斋).

Made by D.S.I. Everest. Forwarded by [签名]

At 3.30 p.m. April 14, 1933, Tsiang Yah Woo (蒋亚武), 1st
class detective attached to the local Bureau of Public Safety,
came to this office with a prisoner named Liang Mai Kong (梁梅康)
and requested assistance in effecting the arrest of an alleged
communist named Yang Ah Zai (杨阿斋). It was ascertained that
the prisoner Liang Mai Kong, who was said to be a former member
of the Chekiang Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth
League, was arrested in Mung Koo Road, Chapei, on April 13. This
prisoner subsequently implicated a man named Yang Ah Zai as being
a member of the Western District Committee of the C.Y.L. and
stated that he resided in the upstairs portion of No.135 Thorburn
Road. The address in question was visited by D.S. Coyne, C.D.C.
216 (Yulin Road Station), D.S.I. Everest, C.D.C. 107 and Clerk
Zung Zoong (Special Branch), accompanied by the Public Safety
Bureau representative and the prisoner Liang Mai Kong at 4.15 p.m.
April 14 when it was found that the wanted man had left Shanghai
for Tsungming in January of this year and had not been seen since.

[签名]
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

[签名]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别支部
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事与特别支部登记处 档案号 D 4781 日期 9月2日 柜号 13）
日期：1933年4月16日

事由（全称）：协助中国当局——逮捕一名名为杨阿斋 (Yang Ah Zai) 的共党嫌疑犯未遂。

呈报人：警探长 Everest。转呈人：[签名]

1933年4月14日下午3时30分，隶属于当地公安局的一等侦探蒋亚武 (Tsiang Yah Woo) 带着一名名为梁梅康 (Liang Mai Kong) 的囚犯来到本办公室，请求协助逮捕一名涉嫌为共党分子的杨阿斋 (Yang Ah Zai)。经查，囚犯梁梅康据称曾是共产主义青年团浙江省委员会的前成员，于4月13日在闸北孟果路被捕。该囚犯随后供出一名名为杨阿斋的男子，称其为共产主义青年团西区委员会成员，并陈述其居住在索伯恩路 (Thorburn Road) 135号的楼上部分。4月14日下午4时15分，警佐 Coyne（玉林路站，警员编号 C.D.C. 216）、警探长 Everest（警员编号 C.D.C. 107）以及特别支部职员 Zung Zoong，在公安局代表和囚犯梁梅康的陪同下前往上述地址，发现被通缉者已于今年一月离开上海前往崇明，此后一直未见踪迹。

[签名]
警探长

特别支部主管警官。

[签名]
